name: Nations of Mankind - Dogs of War

text.content:
The Dogs of War, also known as the Regiments of Renown, is a polite catch-all term to generally describe Mercenaries from all across the known World, fighting on behalf of anyone willing to pay their exorbitant prices. They are drawn to places where fortunes can be won by ruthless adventures. From the lush jungles of the West to the misty isles of the East, and from the steamy swamplands of the South to the harsh snowlands of the north, the world is truly awash with rag-tag armies of sellswords who nurture the wishful dreams of loot, plunder and adventure. Although many Dogs of War ply their bloody trade to every point on the compass, the most notorious breeding-ground of mercenaries lies within the fraction war-torn city-states of Tilea in the Old World. From all the kingdoms of the Old World and many more beyond, sell-swords come towards Tilea in the tens of thousands, reassured of profitable employment and great battles to be won. Tilea is the battleground from which these gold-hungry mercenaries will ply their expertise to all those willing to pay. Yet no matter the motivation, bold armies of Dogs of War depart every few weeks from the ports of Tilea and sail off into the sunset, ready to conqueror new lands and found new Kingdoms the likes of which no man have ever seen before.

 

Cost: Each Mercenary Company charges its own rates, some straight forward and others are bizarre and unique. These Cost rates are flat and pay for exactly one mercenary’s day of service. A full week of service is 3x the listed Cost for the mercenary, however they will not ask for a portion of any loot acquired. Time is money, and these elite mercenaries have no time for simple quick jobs and scuffles, they’re above that. If you wish to hire an entire Unit of mercenaries, the Cost will be multiplied by 10x, however they will not share any additional Traits purchased. To make controlling a Unit easier, add the Swarm Creature Trait to the Unit for the purposes of combat. Optional Traits may be purchased for a single mercenary and increase the GC Cost of the mercenary by 50% of their base price per Trait and an increase in their share of the loot by a percentage equal to their Initial Fellowship Bonus prior to any Traits added. Only one mercenary may have the Leader Trait.

 

Availability: Availability is relative to the Empire and requires a d100 roll by the GM to see if they may be hired within the territory the PCs occupy. If the PCs wish to hire a company from outside of their territory, they must write a letter with half of the required payment to the designated mercenary company and wait. Their request will take 30 + d10 Days until the PC receives an answer, meanwhile it will take 30 – Fellowship Bonus Days for the mercenary, or mercenaries, to arrive should they accept any contract with the PC. The Availability of these mercenaries is increased by 2x when in the lands of Araby, Estalia, Marienburg, The Border Princes or Tilea.
